# Personal-staging extras manifest: one pin per line.
#
# Accepted forms:
#   1234              upstream PR (merged even when closed; GitHub keeps
#                     refs/pull/N/head fetchable after close)
#   branch:<name>     fork branch (resolved on --fork-remote, e.g. origin)
#
# Blank lines and `#` comments are ignored. Remove an entry once the
# change lands upstream (or the fork branch is retired). A ref confirmed
# deleted (`ls-remote` reports it absent) is skipped loudly in the run
# report; a transport failure reaching the remote blocks the hourly push
# (run stays green with a warning); fails the nightly run — that is not
# a cue to edit the manifest. `branch:` names must be legal git branch
# names, must not start with `-`, and must not be `main` or `staging`.
#
# Examples:
# 1234              # keep the composer hotfix until upstream merges it
# branch:homelab    # fork-only justfile recipes, not an upstream PR
#
9473              # bot replacement for closed #9423 (Workspace rail viewer insets)
10032             # bot replacement for closed #10024 (desktop downloads keep request headers)
11105             # deploy entrypoints wire server config like `omnigent server` (RCA #11104)
branch:genie-harness-v2  # #6109 (bbqiu genie CLI harness, head 070ba1ca) merged with upstream 824d804c + Codex signer-key fix; btli genie PRs stack on it
